title: Mechanism by which micro-nano bubbles impact biofilm growth in drinking water distribution systems
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00704B, Paper
Aibao Luo, Tianzhi Wang, Peiyuan Luo, Zhiwei Zheng, Manuel Fiallos, Yongning Bian, Soon-Thiam Khu
Biofilm growth in drinking water distribution systems (DWDS) has become a concern due to the various water quality issues it causes, and thus suitable disinfection methods are required to ensure drinking water safety.
